headline: Linn of Mercy Ignites As High Casualties Shake Central Fronts
war_summary: Linn of Mercy has reignited as the primary flashpoint of active territorial turnover, recording three strategic base exchanges at Lathair alongside over 3,500 combined casualties during the past two hours. In contrast, strategic base transitions have temporarily paused across Stlican Shelf and Weathered Expanse over the latest two-hour stretch, yet combat intensity in both sectors continues to surge: Weathered Expanse racked up nearly 4,900 casualties while Stlican Shelf absorbed over 3,200. Elsewhere along the front lines, brutal attritional battles rage unabated without immediate territorial changes. Callahan's Passage, Nevish Line, and Stonecradle all report accelerating casualty figures and heavy enlistments, with Nevish Line and Callahan's Passage each enduring more than 2,400 losses in the last two hours alone. Meanwhile, Mooring County and Fisherman's Row have quieted down following earlier skirmishes, showing reduced movement as combat shifts toward the contested central and northern sectors.
